title: Enemy file (data/enemies/<id>.json, one enemy per file)
description: An enemy type (TECH_DESIGN §5). Placed in areas as Enemy nodes naming this id.

behaviour.description: hopper: hops after you (slime); archer: keeps its distance and shoots (goblin archer); flier: erratic flight over heights (bat); warden: the keep's boss (stomps, gazes, a weak point stuns it).

health.description: In weapon damage points; the Wooden Sword does 2.

sight.description: How near (px) the hero must come to be noticed.

contact_damage.description: Half hearts lost on touching it.

knockback.description: How far (px) touching it pushes the hero.

shot.description: Archers' arrows, or a warden's bolts.

boss.description: Wardens only: their timings and weak point.

guard_time.description: Seconds it stomps after the hero before gazing.

gaze_time.description: Seconds its eye stays open: the window to stun it.

stun_time.description: Seconds it stays stunned (and can be hurt).

rage_at.description: At this health or less it rages: faster, three bolts. Default: half its health.

weak_point.description: The only kind of hit that stuns it.

drops.description: Weighted table: one entry is picked when it dies.
